title: CI: add RHEL 9 FIPS target (AWS Marketplace PAYG)
description: RHEL 9 proper via AWS Marketplace PAYG (owner 309956199486, no separate subscription needed for on-demand). Same CI flow as Rocky Linux 9 FIPS target: fips-mode-setup --enable + reboot, verify FIPS mode, run full test suite. Required if a customer needs proof of testing on certified RHEL, not just a rebuild.
close_reason: RHEL 9 FIPS: all tests pass on 5.14.0-611.47.1.el9_7.x86_64 with FIPS mode enabled. Fixed: (1) enable CRB repo by RHUI name for RHEL PAYG; (2) kernel version alignment via dnf update kernel + reboot; (3) glibc-static needed for wolfSSL get_thread_size host helper. kernel tests: 4 modules pass (test_shash 12/15 - 3 HMAC TC2 fips_skip vectors correctly excluded).
